problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is tasked with loading a set of distinct shipments onto a fleet of identical cargo planes. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Beta: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment Gamma: mass 69 metric tons
* Shipment Delta: mass 58 metric tons
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 54 metric tons
* Shipment Zeta: mass 39 metric tons
* Shipment Eta: mass 35 metric tons
* Shipment Theta: mass 46 metric tons
* Shipment Iota: mass 54 metric tons
* Shipment Kappa: mass 50 metric tons
* Shipment Lambda: mass 51 metric tons
* Shipment Mu: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment Nu: mass 70 metric tons
* Shipment Xi: mass 57 metric tons
* Shipment Omicron: mass 51 metric tons
* Shipment Pi: mass 42 metric tons
* Shipment Rho: mass 70 metric tons
* Shipment Sigma: mass 31 metric tons
* Shipment Tau: mass 57 metric tons
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 39 metric tons
* Shipment Phi: mass 50 metric tons
* Shipment Chi: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment Psi: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment Omega: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment A1: mass 63 metric tons
* Shipment B1: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment C1: mass 60 metric tons
* Shipment D1: mass 49 metric tons
* Shipment E1: mass 67 metric tons
* Shipment F1: mass 32 metric tons
* Shipment G1: mass 58 metric tons
* Shipment H1: mass 58 metric tons
* Shipment I1: mass 64 metric tons
* Shipment J1: mass 39 metric tons
* Shipment K1: mass 62 metric tons
* Shipment L1: mass 54 metric tons
* Shipment M1: mass 35 metric tons
* Shipment N1: mass 68 metric tons
* Shipment O1: mass 68 metric tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 metric tons. The objective is to load all shipments while utilizing the smallest possible number of planes. Every shipment must be assigned to exactly one aircraft, and the combined mass on any aircraft must not surpass its payload limit.
